acceptanceCriteria: Each mutation receipt records target ID, before status, after status, and changed paths.
Unexpected canonical or generated paths cause an abort with actionable output.
A normal single-task mutation does not enumerate unrelated canonical records.
componentsAffected: Add preflight and post-mutation receipts that declare intended artifact scope and stop on unexpected repository changes.
testSteps: Unit tests for allowed and rejected mutation scopes.

workItem.title: Add mutation scope receipts and changed-path circuit breaker
